description: This file contains automated tests for HTTP/3 and fallback behaviors using the pytest framework, specifically testing curl client interactions with different server configurations and protocols.

classes.name: TestEyeballs
classes.description: A pytest-based test suite class containing multiple tests for HTTP/3 protocol behaviors and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx)
methods.description: Fixture to set up environment for the test class, configuring HTTP/3 support and server reload.

methods.name: test_06_01_h3_only(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test case for downloading data using only HTTP/3 on a server that supports it.

methods.name: test_06_02_h3_only(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test case for attempting HTTP/3 download on a server where HTTP/3 support is missing, expecting failure.

methods.name: test_06_03_h3_fallback_h2(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test case for falling back from HTTP/3 to HTTP/2 when HTTP/3 is either unavailable or fails.

methods.name: test_06_04_h3_fallback_h1(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test case for falling back from HTTP/3 to HTTP/1.1 when HTTP/3 support is absent.

methods.name: test_06_10_stats_success(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test verifying that the connection and application timing stats are properly recorded on a successful HTTPS transfer.

methods.name: test_06_11_stats_fail_verify(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test to check stats when verification fails during HTTPS connection, ensuring connection timing is recorded, but application connect time is zero.

methods.name: test_06_12_stats_fail_tcp(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test that verifies connection failure stats when TCP connection itself fails, with no timings recorded.
